query: I just adopted a little golden retriever puppy yesterday, he’s already chewed through two pairs of my slippers and keeps trying to steal socks off the laundry pile. I spent the whole afternoon today picking out chew toys and puppy food for him online, and I even found a cute little waterproof raincoat that matches my own hiking jacket. Oh, and I was going to bake chocolate chip cookies later, but I realized I ran out of brown sugar so I’ll have to pick that up tomorrow too. Anyway, I need help with a couple of order issues: first, I want to return items 3788616824 from delivered order #W2692684 and 6477915553 from delivered order #W7449508, please refund both to gift_card_7711863. Second, I need to cancel pending order #W9373487 because the items are no longer needed.
